title: The server tracks seen per viewer to fill a field the viewer ignores
body:
`Viewer.seen` in `compositor.rs` is written at three sites in `tell_selection` and the offer path so that `ServerMessage::Offer.seen` can carry it. `viewer.rs` reads `Offer { selection, serial, mimes, .. }`, and `docs/viewer.md` says the viewer adopts every server offer it receives, so the field has no reader by design. The viewer-to-server `seen` stays; `crossed()` reads it.

## Proposal

Drop `seen` from the server-to-viewer `Offer` and drop `Viewer.seen`. A protocol change, but the protocol is unreleased.
